title: Recovery at an indicator vector
statement: Let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$ and let $U\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The algebraic normal form whose coefficient at each set $S$ is the sum of $f(1_T)$ over all $T\subseteq S$ evaluates at $1_U$ to $f(1_U)$, where $1_T$ denotes the vector equal to $1$ on $T$ and $0$ elsewhere.
